install_tell: git clone https://github.com/stitionai/devika && python devika.py  (Flask+gevent on 0.0.0.0:1337; SvelteKit frontend on :3000)
misconfig_patterns: Backend port 1337 internet-exposed -- zero auth on every API endpoint
GET /api/settings returns full config.toml contents including all third-party API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Netlify, Bing, Google Search) with no auth
GET /api/logs returns full application log file unauthenticated
GET /api/get-browser-snapshot?snapshot_path=<path> takes an arbitrary filesystem path parameter with no sanitization -- potential arbitrary file read
POST /api/settings writes to config with no auth -- attacker can overwrite LLM provider endpoints (SSRF via Ollama/LM_Studio endpoint config)
CORS hardcoded to localhost:3000 only -- trivially bypassed with direct requests (curl/httpx)

active_probe.false_positive_check: http.title:"Devika" is most trustworthy (4 Shodan hits vs 19 for http.html:"Devika" which is polluted by South Asian personal name in unrelated content). Negation chains do not reliably strip the personal-name pollution -- the polluting pages do not contain profile/wedding/name tokens. Anchor on GET /api/status returning exactly {"status": "server is running!"} as the live discriminator -- this is a Devika-specific string. Secondary confirm: GET /api/data returns {"models": [...], "projects": [...], "search_engines": ["Bing", "Google", "DuckDuckGo"]} which is unique to Devika. http.html:"stitionai" = 0 hits on Shodan (GitHub org names do not surface). Do not use bare 'Devika' = 3 hits (origin uncertain).

shodan_dorks.note: http.title:"Devika" = 4 hits (most trustworthy -- personal name collision in HTML body avoided). http.html:"devika" = 19 hits (POLLUTED -- South Asian personal name in unrelated content; negation chains don't clean it). "Devika" bare = 3 hits (origin uncertain). http.html:"stitionai" = 0 (GitHub org names don't surface in Shodan). Title dork is the primary gate; verify every hit with GET /api/status discriminator before asserting Devika.

Port 3000 open with SvelteKit frontend titled 'Devika AI' (Docker) or port 3001 (local dev)
Socket.IO connection on port 1337 with 'socket_connect' event emitting 'socket_response'

pivot_paths: GET /api/settings -> full config.toml read including all third-party API keys (HIGHEST VALUE -- no auth)
GET /api/logs -> full application log file (agent task history, LLM prompts/responses, key usage)
GET /api/data -> model list (reveals which LLM providers are configured) + project names
GET /api/get-project-files -> list files written by agent in each project
GET /api/get-browser-snapshot?snapshot_path=<target> -> arbitrary file read candidate (verify path validation before exercising)
vulnerabilities: Unauthenticated config read: GET /api/settings returns all provider API keys from config.toml (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Netlify, Bing, Google) -- zero auth, zero scrubbing.
Unauthenticated config write: POST /api/settings overwrites config with no auth -- can redirect Ollama/LM_Studio endpoints to attacker-controlled host (SSRF primitive).
Potential arbitrary file read: GET /api/get-browser-snapshot?snapshot_path=<path> -- no path sanitization observed in source; serves file contents from arbitrary path parameter.
Full log exposure: GET /api/logs returns complete application log unauthenticated -- leaks agent task content, LLM interactions, and potentially embedded key material.
auth_evidence: devika.py source: Flask app initialized with no auth decorator, no login_required, no token validation on any route. CORS configured via flask_cors but restricted to localhost:3000 origins only -- browser-origin enforcement, not API security. Socket.IO initialized with cors_allowed_origins=['http://localhost:3000', 'https://localhost:3000']. No session management, no middleware, no environment variable for auth config. Config keys stored in config.toml (read/written via /api/settings with no auth). The CORS restriction is the only access control and it is trivially bypassed by direct HTTP requests.
sensitive_assets: All third-party LLM provider API keys via GET /api/settings (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Bing Search, Google Search, Netlify)
Agent execution logs and LLM conversation content via GET /api/logs
Agent-generated project files and code outputs via GET /api/get-project-files and GET /api/download-project
Terminal session state and browser session state via /api/get-terminal-session and /api/get-browser-session
Arbitrary file read via GET /api/get-browser-snapshot?snapshot_path= (unvalidated path parameter)
